Centre de coûts

An organizational unit or account structure within an enterprise used to track, allocate, and report expenses and cloud resource spending for budgeting and financial control.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Centre de coûts?

In this glossary, Centre de coûts refers to: An organizational unit or account structure within an enterprise used to track, allocate, and report expenses and cloud resource spending for budgeting and financial control.

How is Centre de coûts used in IT and DevOps?

In IT and DevOps communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Attribuez chaque ressource cloud à un centre de coûts pour une budgétisation et un reporting des dépenses précis."

Why does Centre de coûts matter in IT and DevOps?

Centre de coûts matters because it supports clear communication in Cloud Operations contexts for DevOps Engineers, SREs, and Platform Engineers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as AWS Certification, Azure Certification, ITIL v4, and CKA/CKAD.

Who uses Centre de coûts?

Centre de coûts is mainly used by DevOps Engineers, SREs, and Platform Engineers.

What category does Centre de coûts belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

An organizational unit or account structure within an enterprise used to track, allocate, and report expenses and cloud resource spending for budgeting and financial control.
